name: Sodi
overview: Sodi is a male figure from the tribe of Zebulun, known primarily as the father of Gaddiel. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed biography provided. He is identified within the context of the wilderness census and tribal listings.
namesAndTitles: The name Sodi means 'y-h-v-h confides,' reflecting a relationship of trust or confidence with the Lord. This proper name is recorded in Numbers 13:10 and is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Sodi as the father of Gaddiel, establishing a direct paternal relationship. He is also noted as a descendant of the tribe of Zebulun. Beyond this, no further family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Sodi's significance lies in his role as the father of Gaddiel, one of the leaders sent to spy out the land of Canaan, as recorded in Numbers 13:10. This connection situates him within the narrative of Israel's journey and God's unfolding plan for the nation. Though not a prominent figure himself, Sodi's lineage contributes to the tribal leadership and the fulfillment of God's promises to the descendants of Zebulun.
